name: unsupported-version-negative-boundary
description: Anchor version is the JSON number -9007199254740991 (-(2^53-1)), exactly the negative edge of the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound spec/resolution.md's Structural Pre-Check step 1 gives every catalogue int field including version; the side is otherwise perfectly well-formed. Round 7's malformed-version-int53-negative-overflow pins the rejecting side one past this edge (-2^53); nothing pins the accepting side, where a decoded version outside {1} must fall through to unsupported-version rather than being wrongly refused as malformed (WRIT-252 round 8 review)
